title: CmdPal: Icons (2/n) - Separate dispatcher delay from icon UI-thread work
summary: Five Copilot findings were fixed on the existing fork review branch and all review threads are resolved. The result remains blocked because the required final fresh Copilot pass did not return and the focused unit tests could not locate testhost.

judgment.rationale: The reviewed upstream head is current and the required builds passed, but a terminal clean review requires a freshly submitted zero-comment Copilot review and successful focused tests. Neither condition was completed before the bounded cutoff.
evidence: The live upstream head is a6e0b8bf19e5d877c0d6c124c2e245d0889f8444.
Five Copilot findings were fixed and all Copilot review threads are resolved.
PowerToys essentials, Runner, Settings, Microsoft.CmdPal.UI, and the Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.UnitTests project built successfully.
The final Copilot review request timed out without a submitted review.
The focused test assembly was built, but vstest.console could not locate testhost, so tests did not execute.
judgment.recommended_action: Resume the existing fork review state, restore the testhost dependency, run the focused unit tests, and obtain a fresh zero-comment Copilot review before approving.

blockers.detail: After five findings were fixed and all threads were resolved, the required final fresh Copilot review timed out without a submitted review.
blockers.remediation: Request Copilot review again on the existing fork review PR at the current head and require a submitted review with zero new comments and zero unresolved threads.

blockers.detail: The Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.UnitTests assembly built, but vstest.console could not locate testhost, so the focused tests did not execute.
blockers.remediation: Restore or provide the Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk testhost output for Microsoft.CmdPal.UI.UnitTests, then rerun the existing targeted vstest command and record the result.

test_evidence.detail: vstest.console could not locate testhost for the built test assembly.
